name: My Long rice paper
summary: Bánh tráng Mỹ Lồng is rice paper of sticky rice and coconut milk, with sugar, salt, and sesame, sometimes milk or egg. Grill it as a snack, or carry it home.
origin: Mỹ Lồng, old xã Mỹ Thạnh, Giồng Trôm. The site’s 20 May 2024 article is the source for the craft.
history: The site says both origin lines and does not choose: about 100 years, from the elders, and a dry-ration story from the Nguyễn–Trịnh years.
Quyết định số 4069/QĐ-BVHTTDL, 30 October 2018, listed this paper and bánh phồng Sơn Đốc as national intangible heritage.
howToEat: Grill it as a snack, or carry it home. The site says the old use was the Tết altar. The yards run all year and longer near Tết.
where: Mỹ Lồng, old xã Mỹ Thạnh, huyện Giồng Trôm. Clause 92 of Nghị quyết 1687/NQ-UBTVQH15 merges Mỹ Thạnh, Thuận Điền, and Lương Phú into xã Lương Phú and does not erase the craft name.
